passageNote: The full barrel-bilge narration (203 spoken characters): a question hook, a named reveal ('the bilge'), a quick explanation and a payoff line. The same text and the same cloned voice in every take; only the delivery variant changes.

variants.name: Natural conversational
variants.description: The script's own punctuation only: no added beats, default sampling.

variants.name: Energetic storyteller
variants.description: No added beats, so it runs straight through; a higher sampling temperature for livelier, more varied prosody (only if the engine accepts temperature, as reported in comparison.json).

variants.name: Expressive, comedic timing
variants.description: Every beat marked in the script becomes an ellipsis the voice can play ('a name… the bilge', 'easy to roll… and easy to turn'), with a slightly raised temperature (if accepted).

honesty: Qwen3-TTS Base (cloning) documents no style, emotion, speed or pitch controls. The variants differ only by text punctuation (always applied) and sampling settings the engine's generate() accepts; ignored settings are listed per take.
